  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsMulLeftInvariant] (f : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ENNReal)
  (hf : Measurable f) :
  ∫⁻ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),

MQuotientHaar.exists_proper_arithmetic_indentation.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
  ∃ b,
    Continuous b ∧
      (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ b x) ∧
        (∀ (C : Set (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)),
            IsCompact C → IsCompact (tsupport b ∩ (C * ↑(MasulloGRH.principalIdeles K)))) ∧
          ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun q => b ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * x)) 1

MQuotientHaar.quotientMeasure_eq_scaled_originalHaar.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]

  [lambda.IsHaarMeasure] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] :

  0 < c ∧ NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda = c • mu
